questions.stem: A clock gains \(5\) minutes per hour. The actual time is 8:00 PM. What time will the clock show after 6 hours?
questions.keySolution:
Clock gains \(5\) minutes per hour
In \(6\) hours, it gains = \(6 × 5 = 30\) minutes
So clock will show \(30\) minutes ahead
Clock time = 8:00 PM + \(30\) minutes = \(8:30 PM\)

questions.stem: A clock gains \(12\) minutes every hour. After how many hours will it show the correct time again?
questions.keySolution:
For clock to show correct time, it must gain \(12\) hours = \(720\) minutes
Time = \(720 / 12 = 60\) hours

questions.stem: Clock A gains \(4\) min/hour, Clock B loses \(6\) min/hour. Both set at \(8:00 AM\). When will they show same time again?
questions.keySolution:
Relative difference = \(4 + 6 = 10\) min/hour
For same time: \(720 / 10 = 72\) hours
